{{Top|leg}}
The '''Department of Punishment''', also known as the '''Bureau of Punishments''', was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] subdivision that was tasked with the [[Torture/Legends|torture]] of captured criminals. The [[Master Torturer]] was the head of the division; [[Sir/Legends|Sir]] [[Vengnar Heiff]] held this position in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was forced to sign a contract (via a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]) that gave [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] direct permission to torture him to [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="SW16">''[[Star Wars Missions 16: Imperial Jailbreak]]''</ref> The [[President/Legends|President]] of the subdivision was murdered by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] partisans during the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|liberation of Coruscant]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].<ref name="COTJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>
